arguments.message: For the evidence handoff, please perform a clearly labeled post-boundary re-observation of a small representative subset of the same final PNGs already displayed (desktop light/dark and narrow), saving each new actual view_image request/response safely under /tmp and copying into your evidence folder. Keep the lost original call and the later observation timestamp/deviation explicit in your report. Preserve all existing observations and limitations.
